title: Better Discs!
description: This resource pack adds new tracks to bad music discs!
body:
This resource pack replaces the bad music disc tracks with awesome ones!
Requires [Jukebox Custom Disc Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/jukebox-custom-disc-fix).

NOTE: To have everything in this pack work properly you will have to set your language to American English (More languages coming out soon!)

Credit to Issac Wilkins, Ryia Aiobahn and Guy Arthur for the awesome music!
